channel.title: CHINESE CULTURE EXPLORER – 中国文化探索
channel.description: Digital Chinese cultural encyclopedia, 3D Forbidden City dissection, 54 master paintings, 34 provincial cultural & travel dossiers, and Sino-Vietnamese scholarly research curated by Lê Hưng Thịnh (黎兴盛).

item.title: Giải phẫu 3D Tử Cấm Thành (紫禁城): Đấu Củng, Trục Đế Vương & Đối Sánh Cố Đô Huế
item.author: Lê Hưng Thịnh (黎兴盛)
item.description: High-detail Three.js 3-state 3D dissection of the Forbidden City (960×750m, 8,886 surveyed bays, 1722 Yangxindian shift, interlocking Dougong timber joinery) paired with East Asian palace parallels at Hue Imperial Citadel.

item.title: Chiến lược Đàm phán B2B 7 Bước với Nhà máy Trung Quốc, NECIPS & Giám định PSI

item.description: Due diligence framework covering NECIPS Unified Social Credit Code lookup, red-star Gongzhang company seals, Định kim (定金) vs Đính kim (订金), and pre-shipment inspection protocols.
